summaryZh: 电力转型实验室研究大规模部署低碳能源所需的工程条件和制度安排，重点关注电网。其主题包括可再生能源资源规划、可负担且可靠的低碳电力市场，以及产业政策和企业低碳转型的政治经济；当前介绍未具体说明研究方法。
researchQuestions: 大规模低碳能源部署需要哪些工程条件与制度安排？

evidence.quote: The Power Transformation Lab at the University of California, San Diego studies the engineering and institutional requirements of deploying low-carbon energy at scale.
Our areas of focus include renewable energy resource planning, affordable and reliable low-carbon power markets, and the political economy of industrial policy and low-carbon transitions in firms.
centering on the role of the power grid.
